title: Concurrency, Persistence, and a Project Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Concurrency, Persistence, and a Project.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes arrays in Go?

options.text: arrays have fixed length as part of their type
use them for truly fixed value-sized data
passing an array copies all elements
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: arrays have fixed length as part of their type. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.
